versions.subject: Merge PR #4521 from @netgrain - Add New Rules Related To Pikabot
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
        # Note: Only add processes seen used by Pikabot to avoid collision with other strains of malware
        - '\searchprotocolhost.exe'
        - '\sndvol.exe'
        - '\wermgr.exe'
        - '\wwahost.exe'
selection_connection:
    Protocol: tcp
    Initiated: 'true'
condition: all of selection_*
